notes.title: More content very soon
notes.content:
Hey everyone, I'm currently working on the next content update for the game. I've been getting extremely helpful reviews and suggestions and I want to thank you all for the overwhelmingly positive feedback it has been getting. Without spoiling too much, I have several more content updates that I'll be adding in the coming months. The game is quite short and small right now but there will be much more in the very near future. This is only the beginning!

Here is a list of things that are currently being worked on:

- Grocery store building
- Apartment building
- Several trains that arrive on a schedule based on your computer's internal clock
- Several "secret" events that happen at times based on your computer's internal clock
- 3 more game cartridges 

The game's future content and updates will largely be determined by what you all want to see from this project, so if you have feedback or want something to be implemented please let me know! I promise that I am listening.

Anyway I love you and have a nice day

- Will
